state_and_ABI_limits.architecture: x86:LE:32 interpretation; no runtime mode or segment descriptor authentication
state_and_ABI_limits.normal_completion: Each local operation is conditional on normal completion, sufficient privilege, valid current segment limits, and readable/writable memory as applicable.
state_and_ABI_limits.implicit_stack: Renew current SS.B=1 before every implicit stack description. Under that predicate PUSH/PUSHFD/near CALL decrement current ESP by four and write via current SS; POP reads via current SS at current ESP and increments it by four. No relation between separately returned current states is assumed.
state_and_ABI_limits.opaque_calls: Every direct and computed call is opaque. Whether it returns is unknown; if control next reaches a saved return cursor, all registers, flags, memory and segment state are newly unknown. No callee convention, argument count, preserved EBP/ESI, preserved SS.B or stack balancing is inferred.
state_and_ABI_limits.segmented_addresses: EBP/ESP-based explicit memory operands default to current SS; absolute and EAX-based memory operands default to current DS. LEA computes an offset and reads no memory; its decoded addressing form does not perform a segment access. SS and DS are never equated.
state_and_ABI_limits.control_flow: Three JE targets are in-range proven starts. Numeric direct-call targets come only from signed displacement arithmetic. The two FF /2 calls read their target from current DS memory at encoded offsets CE222C and CE210C; those cells and their current contents were not read. Separate preceding PUSH instructions occur before those cell reads and may alias the cells under unknown current DS/SS mappings. Each near CALL reads its target operand before its own implicit return-offset stack write; no earlier cell value or non-alias assumption is propagated.
state_and_ABI_limits.segment_stores: Six 66 8C /r instructions store the current 16-bit SS/CS/DS/ES/FS/GS selector values via current SS at EBP-relative offsets. They do not authenticate any segment descriptor or equality of segment bases.
state_and_ABI_limits.pushfd_pop: PUSHFD uses its architectural flag image under the applicable mode/privilege conditions; no assertion equates that image with every current EFLAGS bit. The following POP memory is a current-SS operation, conditional on its own current state and normal completion.
state_and_ABI_limits.interrupt: CC at C04ED4 is INT3, a software breakpoint exception, not a near CALL. Capstone lists MODIFY_IF/NT/RF/TF as coarse interrupt effects; actual mode/gate/handler effects and any later continuation are unknown. C04ED5 was neither queried nor classified.
state_and_ABI_limits.ABI: No recovered function prototype, calling convention, argument layout, library identity, provider binding or semantic nonreturn proof is established.
